ST-06.title: Canonical keyboard-shortcut inventory spec
ST-06.notes: Documentation-creation story (Case B). Grepped Layout.js, CommandPalette.js, TradeEntry.js, TradePlan.js, RedFlagJournal.js and TickerUniverse.js for every onKeyDown/e.key handler (confirmed exhaustive via a second broader re-scan). Found: 4 global document-level shortcuts (Layout.js's n/w/r, CommandPalette.js's Cmd/Ctrl+K), already documented in navigation.md's existing Keyboard Shortcuts section, plus 4 page-local element-scoped Enter/Space handlers (tag-add in TradeEntry.js/TradePlan.js, filter-apply in RedFlagJournal.js, a custom role=button badge's keyboard-activation in TickerUniverse.js) that had no documented home anywhere -- exactly the gap BLG-SPEC-159 describes. Added both tables plus a conflict analysis to navigation.md v1.6->1.7: no conflicts found, and the reason is structural (global handlers are input-focus-suppressed by construction, so they and the page-local handlers are mutually exclusive by focus state; the 4 global shortcuts don't collide with each other since Cmd/Ctrl+K's own handler is gated behind the exact modifier check Layout.js's bare-key handler excludes). No conflicts required filing, satisfying the AC's 'conflicts resolved or filed' as 'none exist.'
